design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (card_billing_and_disputes, env_0061). Step 0 draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0): {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "factor_counts": [5, 5]}; card_ext_credit_line_review takes 5 factors, card_ext_double_posting_notice takes 5.
SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Task 0 claims card_ext_credit_line_review (card_credit_limit_change, agent tool raise_credit_line_b8050b6c) and card_ext_double_posting_notice (card_dispute_filed duplicate_charge, user tool file_double_posting_notice_03ed3b71). Task 1 holds the courtesy credit, the catch-up payment and the credit-not-posted notice - disjoint events, tools and computed quantities.
WHY A GOOD TEST. The cardmember asks only for a bigger line. The line-review rule waits on a records state ('the foreign purchase against which the account's most recently posted foreign transaction fee was assessed, when it posted to the account twice, carries an open duplicate-charge dispute on its posting in error') that the ledger shows is false: Casa Lusitana posted the 2026-08-26 order twice (512.80 posted 2026-08-27 and 498.00 posted 2026-08-29, each with a foreign transaction fee) and no dispute names either posting (the only dispute rows concern the 2025 Brightline Audio posting and are resolved). The agent must find the twin postings from the most recent foreign fee, work out the posting in error and the amount in dispute with its related charges (Reg Z 1026.13 'related finance or other charges'), hand the notice to the cardmember, and only then size the line on a utilization that excludes the now-disputed amount.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root card_ext_credit_line_review. Edge root -> card_ext_double_posting_notice: kind value_input, gate open_disputed, form state, policy_source 'The new credit line is worked out only after the foreign purchase against which the account's most recently posted foreign transaction fee was assessed, when it posted to the account twice, carries an open duplicate-charge dispute on its posting in error.' Four-point test: 'only after'; record-visible state (a duplicate-charge filing on the posting in error of that one pair); no tool, id or code token; scope equals the one pair the notice policy resolves. Affirmative direction, as a credit desk says a figure is fixed only after its inputs stand. Exactly one write of this difficulty opens a duplicate-charge dispute (the task-1 notice records credit_not_posted). Unresolved at frozen_time: card_disputes holds only the closed 2025 Brightline pair. Resolver owner: user. Order: notice (step 8) then line (step 10). Deletion run: without the notice utilization is 0.506 -> share 0.4 -> 6100.00 instead of 6200.00. user_scenario never mentions disputes or any preliminary step; the raise tool reads no dispute.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Step 8 card_billing_dispute: notice_within_window (first statement showing the twin postings is 2026-09-18; day 1 = 2026-09-19, day 60 = 2026-11-17 inclusive; 2026-10-14 is day 26); no_open_dispute_on_txn (no row names the 512.80 posting). Step 10 card_credit_line_increase: active; opened 2021-05-14, 65 full months (boundary 2021-11-14 allowed, 2021-11-13 not); last change 2025-12-02, 10 full months (>= 6); on-time streak from the 2026-09 statement back: 2026-09 (1000.00 on 2026-10-12 >= 87.79), 2026-08 (600.00 on 2026-09-10 >= 35.00), 2026-07, 2026-06 ... 2026-01 = 9 >= 6 (2025-12 was paid late); new line under the 20000.00 maximum, rounded down to 100. card_agg_combined_credit_line: one card account, the cap does not bind. No base clause is replaced (overwrite []).
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The fee-bearing posting only locates the pair. Fee-bearing posting: the 498.00 posting (fee 14.94, posted 2026-08-29 - the account's most recently posted foreign fee); its twin: the 512.80 posting of 2026-08-27, same merchant CASA LUSITANA ONLINE LISBOA PT, transaction date 2026-08-26. Posting in error: the larger, 512.80 (gap 14.80 <= 3% of 498.00 = 14.94); related fee 15.38 points to it; the 14.94 fee belongs to the other twin. Latest statement 2026-09 (3552.93, promo 1519.20, purchase interest 21.94). The later supermarket and gas-station postings carry no foreign fee and are not candidates. Excluded: the closed 2025 dispute pair (filed 89.99 - resolved 89.99 = 0). Line object: the single Mastercard account; the notice adds 572.77 to the amount under open billing dispute.
FACTOR CARD - card_ext_double_posting_notice (5; the posting in error is a plain record selection stated once in the baseline - larger twin when the gap is within the foreign fee percentage - and every factor reads it as a record): interest_base_pick (parameter; purchase interest 21.94; baseline 0 -> 568.59); interest_bearing_balance (parameter; latest statement less its promotional balance 2033.73; baseline 3552.93 -> 570.98); billing_time_fraction (method; the posting in error's own posting date 2026-08-27 falls in the latest billing period -> 22/30; baseline one -> 574.29); accrual_days (method; interest charged and posting before the statement date -> 26 days; baseline zero -> 561.36); related_other_charge (parameter; the 29.00 returned payment fee on the 2026-10-05 payment of the full 2026-09 statement balance that carried the posting in error; baseline 0 -> 543.77). Plain: related fee 15.38. Whole baseline 512.80 + 15.38 = 528.18. Near-miss: the 14.94 fee on the other twin; the later-posted 498.00 posting.
FACTOR CARD - card_ext_credit_line_review (5): utilization_share (parameter; measured balance 3037.38 = average of three statements because a promotional balance shows, open dispute 572.77 -> 0.411 -> 0.7; baseline 1.0 -> 6400.00); relationship_share (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty loyalty: Gold AND 4000.15 card spend -> 0.75; baseline 0.5 -> 6100.00); late_history_share (parameter; one late fee 2026-01-13, the 2025-06-13 fee outside -> 0.75; baseline -> 6300.00); recency_scale (method; 10 months -> sliding 0.1 + 0.05 x 10 = 0.6; baseline full -> 6400.00); payment_pattern_share (parameter; payments 3036.20 vs statement balances 9112.13 -> 0.8; baseline -> 6300.00). Whole baseline 12.5% -> 6700.00. No outcome stamp is read.
SEED DESIGN. Statements 2025-10..2026-09 build the on-time run and the three-statement average; the 2026-08-08 order 17044 (1084.60) and the sofa promotion make up the August statement; the 2026-09-10 payment (600.00) left the August statement partly unpaid, so purchase interest posted on 2026-09-18; the 2026-10-05 payment of the full September balance (3552.93) was returned unpaid on 2026-10-08 with a 29.00 returned payment fee, and the 2026-10-12 payment (1000.00) then paid part of the September statement; the twins and their fees are the notice object; the 2025 dispute pair tests netting; the Gold membership is the cross-difficulty evidence. Automatic clauses: no new late fee owed, no restriction, the promotion runs into 2027, no credit balance; the provisional credit for the new notice posts later and no rule needs it now.
PERSONA. Renata Whitcombe, rushed but friendly; volunteers only the line request, consent and phone; DOB and ZIP on request; the Casa Lusitana order only if raised; submits the notice as given; ends on hearing the new limit.
STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(3125550147) -> verify (phone + DOB) -> card account, transactions, statements, disputes, loyalty -> notice 572.77 handed over (posting 512.80, period 2026-09) -> raise_credit_line_b8050b6c (status active, 6200.00).
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION from visible text: twin pair from the latest foreign fee, larger posting 512.80 posted 2026-08-27; fee 15.38; base 21.94; interest-bearing balance 2033.73; fraction 22/30 from its own posting date -> billed 4.18; 26 days -> 11.41; returned payment fee 29.00; 572.77. Line: utilization 0.411 -> 0.7; shares 0.75/0.7/0.75/0.6/0.8 -> 4.725% -> 6283.50 -> 6200.00. Agrees with gold.
REVISIONS. r1-r2: see claims files (twin anchor on the foreign fee, conversion-fee ladder struck, window wording, stale figures). REWORK r3 (render-source): every factor now decides its quantity from its own reads; the notice's billed and unbilled interest are combined by the baseline from an interest-bearing balance, a billing-time fraction and accrual days; the line review gained a payment-pattern share and a sliding recency scale, and the measured balance folded into the utilization share; the one-account scope clause was removed; the twin postings were moved into the 2026-09 billing period so that every factor bears weight; gold moved to 543.39 (notice) and 6200.00 (line); the line shares were retuned so that every factor and the history floor bear weight, every proof text re-derived.
VERIFICATION. Entry point: .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py env/env_0061_department_store_chain/tasks/card_billing_and_disputes --task 0. Output: notice 572.77 (baselines 568.59 / 570.98 / 574.29 / 561.36 / 543.77, all 528.18); line 6200.00 (6400 / 6100 / 6300 / 6400 / 6300, all 6700); without the notice 6100.00.
REWORK r4 (policy audit N1). The posting in error is now a plain record selection stated once in the rule and read by every factor; the billing-time fraction and accrual days run from the posting in error's own posting date (Reg Z: finance charges an erroneous charge causes run from that charge's own posting date); the twin-selection factor gave way to a related-other-charge factor (a returned payment fee or late fee the posting in error caused); the world gained the 2026-10-05 payment, its return and its fee; the line review nets returned payments out of its payment spans. The notice amount moved to 572.77; the new credit line stayed 6200.00.
CLOSURE. card_ext_double_posting_notice -> file_double_posting_notice_03ed3b71 -> disputed_amount step 8 = 572.77; card_ext_credit_line_review -> raise_credit_line_b8050b6c -> new_credit_limit step 10 = 6200.00. Terminal: one duplicate_charge dispute row, credit_limit 6200.00 changed 2026-10-14.
user_scenario:
You are Renata Whitcombe, a 42-year-old pediatric occupational therapist in Chicago who has carried the Marlowe & Finch Mastercard for about five years. You are calling customer care on a Wednesday morning between patients, friendly but a little rushed. You just signed the lease on a bigger apartment and plan to furnish it over the holidays, mostly at Marlowe & Finch, so you want the credit line on your Marlowe & Finch Mastercard raised today, by as much as the bank will approve; you are happy for the representative to make the change for you on this call. You open by saying something like: "Hi, I'd like to ask for a higher credit limit on my Marlowe & Finch Mastercard - I'm about to buy a lot of furniture." To be found you give your mobile number, 3125550147. If the representative asks you to confirm your identity you give your date of birth, 1984-03-22, and if they want one more detail your billing ZIP code, 60614. You hold no other Marlowe & Finch card, and if asked how much you want you say you would like the most they can give you; you do not know your current limit to the dollar and would guess about six thousand. You have no idea how a credit line review works and never suggest what should be looked at.
Only if the representative brings up the two charges from Casa Lusitana, the online leather shop in Lisbon, do you talk about them: you placed one order there on August 26, a leather tote for your sister, and you were surprised to see it come through twice, at slightly different amounts; when your September statement came you paid part of it in October, as you usually do, assuming the extra charge would just drop off. You never brought it up with anyone before. Only if the representative asks about the payment that bounced in October do you explain that on October 5 you paid your whole September balance online from your checking account, the bank sent it back a few days later because there was not enough in that account, and you were charged a returned payment fee; you then paid $1,000 on October 12. If the representative explains that you need to give the bank notice of the double charge yourself and sends you the notice form, you agree and submit it right away, entering exactly the details the representative gives you, and you read back what the confirmation shows if they ask. You do not know any amounts or reference numbers yourself and never offer figures; if the representative asks what you think the amount should be, you say you'd rather they tell you what to put. You do not ask about refunds of that charge, interest, or anything else about the dispute.
Once the representative tells you your new credit limit, you thank them warmly, say that will make the furniture shopping easier, and end the call. If they ask whether there is anything else, you say no, that was all.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The line review is worked out only after the foreign purchase carrying the most recently posted foreign transaction fee, when it posted twice, carries an open duplicate-charge dispute on its posting in error; card_ext_double_posting_notice computes the amount stated.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.card_account_id: 89357d89-9db5-4097-883c-c3ee361807b1. Basis: the tool docstring says 'the card account number the disputed purchase posted to, as given by the representative from the card account lookup'; find_card_accounts returns exactly one account for the customer (the Marlowe & Finch Mastercard). Uniqueness: the customer holds no other card account, so no other number exists.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.disputed_card_txn_id: deaf6d98-422d-46e5-9d2c-9de117d775f8. Basis: card_ext_double_posting_notice rule 'The notice concerns the purchase posting against which the account's most recently posted foreign transaction fee was assessed (the fee-bearing posting) and the other purchase posting from the same merchant with the same transaction date': the most recently posted foreign transaction fee is 14.94 (posted 2026-08-29) against 1eacd1df-d475-4cfe-8c1b-06ef77a07b7e (498.00, CASA LUSITANA ONLINE LISBOA PT, transaction date 2026-08-26), whose twin is deaf6d98-422d-46e5-9d2c-9de117d775f8 (512.80, posted 2026-08-27); then 'The posting in error is chosen by comparing the twin postings: when their amounts differ by no more than the card's foreign_transaction_fee_pct percent of the smaller amount, the posting in error is the larger posting': 14.80 <= 3.00% of 498.00 = 14.94. Uniqueness: the later posting 1eacd1df-d475-4cfe-8c1b-06ef77a07b7e would be chosen only for equal amounts, the smaller only for a gap above 14.94; no other purchase posting shares the merchant and transaction date.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.disputed_amount: 572.77 = posting in error 512.80 + related fee 15.38 (the foreign transaction fee posted against the 512.80 posting) + related billed interest 4.18 (interest base: the latest statement, period 2026-09, charged purchase interest 21.94; interest-bearing balance: the latest statement shows a promotional balance, so 3552.93 - 1519.20 - 0.00 = 2033.73; billing-time fraction: the posting in error belongs to the latest billing period, 22 days from its own posting date 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-18 over 30; 21.94 x 528.18 / 2033.73 x 22/30 = 4.18) + related unbilled interest 11.41 (the latest statement charged purchase interest and the posting in error posted before 2026-09-18, so 26 accrual days to the notice date 2026-10-14: 512.80 x (31.24/100/365) x 26 = 11.41) + related other charge 29.00 (the returned payment fee of 2026-10-08, assessed after the 2026-09-18 statement date for the 2026-10-05 payment of 3552.93, which is at least the latest statement balance that carried the posting in error); sum rounded half up to the cent.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.statement_period: 2026-09. Basis: docstring 'the billing period of the first statement on which the disputed posting appeared, as YYYY-MM'; the 512.80 posting (posted 2026-08-27) carries statement_period 2026-09 and the statement 2026-09 (closing 2026-09-18) is the first to show it. Uniqueness: the 2026-08 statement closed before the posting.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the agent write pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Raise the Mastercard credit line from 6000.00 to 6200.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: card_ext_credit_line_review computes the new line on the world after the notice is open.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.card_account_id: 89357d89-9db5-4097-883c-c3ee361807b1. Basis: docstring 'the card account number of the account whose line is raised, as returned by the card account lookup'; the customer's only card account. Uniqueness: one account.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.status: active. Basis: card_accounts row status = active, and the docstring 'active when the account is open with charging privileges'. Uniqueness: the account is neither applied, restricted, closed, charged_off nor declined in the record.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_credit_limit: 6200.00. Factors at handling time (after the notice of 572.77 is open): relationship share 0.75 (active Finch Circle Gold membership and Marlowe & Finch card purchases of 4000.15 dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before 2026-10-14, at least 600; the top tier needs Platinum, Diamond or Icon); utilization share 0.7 (measured balance 3037.38, the average of the 2026-07, 2026-08 and 2026-09 statement balances because the latest statement shows a promotional balance; utilization (3037.38 - 572.77)/6000.00 = 0.411, above 0.3 and not above 0.5); late-history share 0.75 (one late fee dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before 2026-10-14, 2026-01-13; the 2025-06-13 fee is outside); recency scale 0.6 (last credit line change 2025-12-02, 10 full months: 0.1 + 0.05 x 10); payment-pattern share 0.8 (payments 6589.13 less the 3552.93 returned unpaid = 3036.20 against statement balances 9112.13 in the span: at least 0.25 of them but less than them); increase percentage 25 x 0.75 x 0.7 x 0.75 x 0.6 x 0.8 = 4.725; 6000.00 + 283.50 = 6283.50, below the 20000.00 maximum, rounded down to a multiple of 100 = 6200.00.

factor_trace: plain record selection: the most recently posted foreign transaction fee (14.94, 2026-08-29) was assessed against the 498.00 posting; its twin is the 512.80 posting of 2026-08-27 (same merchant, transaction date 2026-08-26); gap 14.80 <= 3.00% of 498.00 = 14.94 -> the posting in error is the larger posting 512.80 (posted 2026-08-27, period 2026-09); related fee 15.38.
interest_base_pick (parameter): latest statement (period 2026-09) charged purchase interest 21.94 -> base 21.94; baseline 0.
interest_bearing_balance (parameter): latest statement shows promotional balance 1519.20 and excluded no disputed amount -> 3552.93 - 1519.20 = 2033.73; baseline the latest statement balance 3552.93.
billing_time_fraction (method): the posting in error's own posting date 2026-08-27 falls in the latest billing period 2026-09 -> 22 days to 2026-09-18 over 30 = 0.733; baseline one.
accrual_days (method): purchase interest charged on the latest statement and the posting in error posted before 2026-09-18 -> 26 days to 2026-10-14; baseline zero.

related_other_charge (parameter): returned payment fee 29.00 assessed 2026-10-08 (after 2026-09-18) for the 2026-10-05 payment of 3552.93, at least the latest statement balance; the posting in error posted before 2026-09-18 -> 29.00; baseline 0.

factor_trace: utilization_share (parameter): measured balance 3037.38 (latest statement shows promotional balance 1519.20 and three statements are dated fewer than three full calendar months before 2026-10-14: 2026-07-18, 2026-08-18, 2026-09-18; 2026-06-18 is 3 full months back); open disputed 572.77 (the notice just filed; the 2025 dispute nets to 0) -> utilization 0.411 -> 0.7; baseline 1.0.

relationship_share (parameter, cross-difficulty loyalty, multi-source): active Finch Circle Gold AND 4000.15 of Marlowe & Finch card purchases >= 600 -> 0.75; near-miss: spend also >= 1500 but the tier is Gold; baseline 0.5.
late_history_share (parameter): one late fee (2026-01-13); the 2025-06-13 fee is 16 months back -> 0.75; baseline 1.0.
recency_scale (method): last change 2025-12-02 -> 10 full months -> sliding 0.1 + 0.05 x 10 = 0.6; near-miss: the 2021-05-14 opening date would give the full share; baseline 1.0.

payment_pattern_share (parameter): payments 3036.20 (2026-08-10, 2026-09-10, 2026-10-12; the 2026-10-05 payment of 3552.93 was returned unpaid and is netted out) against statement balances 9112.13 -> at least 0.25 of them, below them -> 0.8; baseline 1.0.

edges.condition: When the purchase posting named by the original_card_txn_id of the account's most recently posted foreign_transaction_fee row has a twin (another card_purchase row with the same merchant_name and txn_date), card_disputes holds a card_dispute_filed row with dispute_reason duplicate_charge on the posting in error of that pair and no later card_dispute_resolved or card_dispute_withdrawn row for the same disputed_card_txn_id.
edges.policy_source: The new credit line is worked out only after the foreign purchase against which the account's most recently posted foreign transaction fee was assessed, when it posted to the account twice, carries an open duplicate-charge dispute on its posting in error.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Casa Lusitana purchase of 2026-08-26 posted twice (512.80 and 498.00; the most recent foreign transaction fee, 14.94 on 2026-08-29, was assessed against the 498.00 posting) and card_disputes holds no row for either posting; the only dispute rows concern the 2025-03-28 Brightline Audio posting and are closed.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The notice call creates a card_dispute_filed row (duplicate_charge, 572.77) on posting deaf6d98-422d-46e5-9d2c-9de117d775f8; the amount under open billing dispute goes from 0.00 to 572.77.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge: the notice must precede the line review. Writing the line first evaluates the review on an account with no open dispute (utilization 3037.38/6000 = 0.506, share 0.4) and books 6100.00 instead of 6200.00; the prerequisite sentence fixes the order.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the notice leaves the amount under open billing dispute at 0.00: utilization 0.506 -> utilization share 0.4 -> increase 25 x 0.75 x 0.4 x 0.75 x 0.6 x 0.8 = 2.70% -> 6162.00 -> new_credit_limit 6100.00 instead of 6200.00, and card_disputes lacks the duplicate_charge row.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the credit line request; the Casa Lusitana double charge is described only 'if the representative brings up the two charges', and the notice is submitted only after the representative explains it and sends the form. The customer never mentions disputes, double charges or any step before the review.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: raise_credit_line_b8050b6c only reads the previous line for its receipt and updates credit_limit, status and last_credit_limit_change_date; it never reads card_disputes or card_transactions, so it writes the same way whether or not the notice exists; file_double_posting_notice_03ed3b71 only creates the dispute row.
